## [Very frustrating experience, never again..👎](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64ccdb41c4234462868ed1af)
Because the website is malfunctioning I cannot use my points, so they decided to tell me I cannot use points for items that are on sale. Go to another site that is more consumer friendly.

July 19, 2023

* * *

Useful

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 4, 2023

Hi Sharon,

Thank you so much for reaching out! We're happy to clarify our rewards program. Once you apply the points, they're added as a promo code. Please keep in mind that we are unable to combine rewards points with any other promos or offers and the maximum points that can be used per order is 2,000 points ($200 off). Points can only be used towards the merchandise total, and cannot be applied to tax or shipping.

For more information please feel free to check out our rewards points: https://www.luluandgeorgia.com/pages/rewards.
